Built on the original game by akouzoukos and running natively through Metal without an emulator, with the game's engine rebuilt specifically for Apple platforms. Control the game using touch gestures where the whole screen acts as the surface: drag left or right to move, drag down for a soft drop, flick down for a hard drop, tap to rotate, use two fingers for 180-degree rotation, swipe up to hold, and long-press for Zone.
com.rebelancap.apotris.subtitle: Fast and feature-packed native block-stacking game

com.rebelancap.ghostship.description: Run Ghostship on your iPhone and Apple Vision Pro with full game saves, the Ghostship enhancements menu, game controller support, and a tunable touch layout. com.rebelancap.ghostship.subtitle: Play Ghostship on iPhone and Apple Vision Pro

com.rebelancap.openq4.description: openQ4 runs the full Quake 4 story campaign, an offline Arena Campaign against bots, and multiplayer between openQ4 players. On Apple Vision Pro it adds a stereoscopic 3D mode that displays the game on a floating screen with real depth. The app uses the open‑source openQ4 engine replacement, running its Vulkan renderer natively on Metal via MoltenVK. No game content is included; you must own Quake 4 and supply the retail q4base folder patched to 1.4.2 (Steam and GOG releases are already patched; disc installs require the official 1.4.2 patch).
com.rebelancap.openq4.subtitle: Play Quake 4 on iOS and Vision Pro

com.rebelancap.paperboat.description: PaperBoat is a native port of Paper Mario 64 for iPhone. The app extracts your ROM on the device without a PC or companion app. Built on the Harbour Masters port and libultraship, it renders natively via Metal. A customizable touch layout lets you drag, scale, fade, or hide every button, and the analog stick appears under your left thumb. External game controllers are supported.
com.rebelancap.paperboat.subtitle: Play Paper Mario 64 natively on iPhone

com.rebelancap.perfectdark.description: Perfect Dark is Rare's classic N64 shooter running natively on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro. Features include jump, a combat roll, melee combos, a third-person camera, a Combat Simulator simulant cap raised from 8 to 80, and persistent bodies. It also includes XBLA support to draw high-resolution textures, meshes, rooms, fonts, and explosions from the 2010 Xbox 360 release using your own copy.
com.rebelancap.perfectdark.subtitle: Rare's N64 shooter running natively on iOS and visionOS

com.rebelancap.q2repro.description: Play Quake II on your iPhone and Apple Vision Pro, including the full campaign, both mission packs, the 2023 re-release content, and Action Quake II. com.rebelancap.q2repro.subtitle: Play Quake II on iPhone and Apple Vision Pro

com.rebelancap.quake3e.description: Play Quake III Arena on your iPhone and Apple Vision Pro with a full single-player bot ladder, real internet multiplayer, and mods.
